comments.author: exponentia
comments.body_html:
Sorting the stash with any loose items pulls items from every location to stack with it. This means out of containers but worst of all it means from the character as well. Makes it extremely inconvenient either before cases or with stuff you don’t want in cases but have different needs for the same item. For example, I keep 5k roubles, 500 of each other currency in a wallet for extracts and I keep spare loose ammo on my character. I need to recheck this before every raid if I sorted my stash as although I keep spare ammo in an ammo container, if even 1 bullet that matches the ammo I’m using gets loose in the stash I’ll go into the raid with no spare ammo, and I have to refill my cash every time as I don’t use containers for cash in my stash (I use large stack sizes for cash) and it’ll pull it straight out of my wallet. Also if I accidentally sort my character wallet all my money jumps out of my stash.

I think it should pull from containers in the same stash (unless you’re going to implement auto stacking inside containers) but it shouldn’t pull across from character to stash or vice versa.
